Thanks for the forward. Quick answers: 

- Treasury prefers a bank letter or voided check for ACH setup but will accept ACH auth + micro-deposit verification for new vendors if bank letter is delayed. Please indicate on the intake form which option Nebula will provide.
- Insurance: standard SaaS supplier must have general liability and cyber liability; minimum limits listed in the vendor agreement. If Nebula cannot provide COI immediately, mark as pending and set a 30-day compliance SLA.
- PO creation: create PO against Vendor ID once procurement enters vendor record; for initial onboarding credit, add a line item code ONB-CRD and note budget owner Marcus Lin. I will create the PO template and share.

I attached a short Vendor_Create_Form PDF for the vendor team to use.
